summary: Theme snapshot change preserves existing access gates: public snapshots accept only an enum theme matching the saved approved owner portfolio. Review scope is the theme field and publication change, not a claim that every existing app limitation is resolved.

checks.createAndUpdate: Both require owner identity, server timestamps and the same snapshot validator.
checks.authority: Public theme must match the owner-only saved source config.
checks.businessLogic: Modern Blue legacy default and Minimal White publication tested in the emulator/browser.
checks.storageAndTypes: Only two fixed string enum values are accepted; arbitrary CSS and large values are rejected.
checks.identity: Theme changes cannot bypass existing owner, approval, revision, redaction or public-list denial rules.
